name: Al-Qurashī’s algebra commentary
summary: A North African commentary explaining Abū Kāmil's algebra, now lost except for fragments quoted in a later book by Ibn Zakariyā.
description: Al-Qurashī’s commentary on Abū Kāmil, known through later testimony and surviving fragments in Ibn Zakariyā’s book.
tier_reason: A particular partially preserved commentary fits fine detail; absence of an autograph does not make its historical report false. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.

market.note: This node is scoped to mathematical knowledge and scholarly interpretation.

date.label: By 1407 (identity and death-date uncertain)
date.basis: The 2013 Djebbar republication gives 1404 for Ibn Zakariyā; his 2018 article gives 1407 for Ibn Zakariyā of Granada. A by-1407 bound applies if these references identify the same commentator.

events.statement: Ibn Zakariyā’s book preserves fragments of al-Qurashī’s algebra commentary.
events.caveats: Djebbar’s 2013 account gives the commentator’s death as 1404, while his 2018 account gives 1407 for Ibn Zakariyā of Granada; identifying the two references is an inference pending direct comparison of the underlying manuscript. The earlier commentary survives only indirectly; neither first circulation nor a direct influence on Ibn al-Bannāʾ is established.

evidence.supports: Al-Qurashī commented on Abū Kāmil’s algebra and died in 1184; later sources preserve fragments.
